thread:
rachel: Quick heads-up: evening change window 20:00-20:20 UTC. Cross-service plan: API pin -> Router header switch -> Runtime kernel toggle -> Console schema push. Want an explicit early-revert play in case router header negotiation breaks old clients.

 arjun: Agree. Suggest API go canary 3% for 4m. Router shift only after API steady. Early-revert play: cut router traffic to 0% and enable legacy-headers for 15m then decide.

 matt: Who has privilege to flip legacy-headers? ops-bot? Need runbook snippet in this thread.

 ops-bot: OpsBot: legacy-headers toggle is gated. Runbook excerpt:
```
1) ops toggle legacy-headers=true on router-backup pool
2) Shift traffic from new-router pool -> router-backup (staged 25% steps)
3) Monitor :hdr_neg_fail and /v1/generate p95 for 10m
4) If stable, keep; else rollback API pin
```

 rachel: perfect. add metric watchlist: /v1/generate p95, :hdr_neg_fail, runtime_kv_miss_rate, console_schema_warnings. Thresholds: p95 +40% or hdr_neg_fail >0.2% for 5m -> trigger early-revert.

 arjun: DeployBot preflight please. Also add annotation in release-notes: "kernel-batching toggle and router header negotiation change" so customers on enterprise clusters can be alerted.

 deploybot: DeployBot: preflight OK. Pins set: API=2.6.3, Router=2.1.4. Quiet window reserved 20:00-20:20 UTC.

 matt: running staging header-smoke now. curl test: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-router.redwood.internal/echo -H 'x-rd-hdr: new' -d '{"ok":1}'
```
 matt: staging returned 200 and header echoed. KV miss-rate unchanged.

 rachel: starting API canary 3% in 2m. arjun will run router shift after 4m if stable. matt, you'll be oncall for early-revert?

 matt: yes i'll execute early-revert steps if thresholds hit. ops-bot has the toggle.

 deploybot: DeployBot: API canary started 3% -> p95=88ms errors=0.

 deploybot: DeployBot: after 4m canary steady. API progressed to 25%.

 arjun: initiating router pin and staged traffic shift to 25%. watch :hdr_neg_fail.

 deploybot: DeployBot: router pinned 2.1.4. traffic now 25%. :hdr_neg_fail=0.02% p95 delta +8ms.

 rachel: looks good. proceeding to runtime kernel toggle in canary after 10m. Console will begin schema rollout afterwards.

 ops-bot: OpsBot: reminder - early-revert keys stored in /ops/runbooks/router-rollback. Notify @eng-sre on revert.

 deploybot: DeployBot: window complete. final: API=2.6.3 (p95=95ms), Router=2.1.4 (:hdr_neg_fail=0.03%), Runtime kernel-batching=ON in gold pool, Console schema gradual. No early-revert triggered.
